# Release notes 3.8

## Highlights
- Faster cold start (about 30% lower)
- New export wizard
- Dark theme refresh

## Known issues
- Export wizard fails on files over 2 GB
- Tray icon blurry on 4K displays
- Dark theme flickers on first launch

## Upgrade notes
Back up your settings before upgrading.
